button.danger: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold rounded-lg px-6 py-3

empty_state.description: A classic vintage car covered in soap foam at a carwash during nighttime. Used for the empty state background with high opacity overlay.

key_features: List of scheduled car washes (showing car name, model, pickup time)
Create new schedule form (car name, model, pickup time/date)
Edit existing schedule (tap item to open edit screen with pre-filled fields)
Delete schedule with confirmation dialog ('Deseja realmente excluir este agendamento?')
Real-time search bar at top of list (filter by car name, case-insensitive)
Empty state when no schedules exist
Floating action button or prominent '+' to add new schedule

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Since the stack dictates .js files, ensure any code provided adheres to Javascript (no Typescript interfaces).
Implement expo-sqlite logic tailored to local storage requirements as specified.
Ensure all UI text is strictly in Portuguese (pt-BR).
Search functionality must be real-time and case-insensitive on the 'car name' field.
Delete confirmation dialog must use the exact text: 'Deseja realmente excluir este agendamento?'.
Use the Volt Blue (#007AFF) for the primary FAB and call-to-actions, maintaining strong contrast against the Dark Theme.
The empty state should feature the provided vintage car wash image with a heavy dark overlay to ensure text readability.
Follow 'Performance Pro' Archetype strictly. Avoid any 'teal' colors. Use 1px borders instead of shadows where possible.
